description: This file defines a Smarty plugin that compiles the 'from_charset' modifier, which converts character encoding from a specified charset to Smarty's internal charset. It contains the implementation of the smarty_modifiercompiler_from_charset function used during template compilation.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_from_charset
methods.description: Compiles PHP code to perform character encoding conversion from a specified charset to Smarty's internal charset during template compilation.
